claims: Jacie Hoyt is the head coach of the Oklahoma State University women's basketball team.
Jacie Hoyt was hired in March 2022.
Jacie Hoyt is in her fourth season (2025-2026) leading the Cowgirls.
Jacie Hoyt recently secured her first NCAA Tournament win with the team.
Jacie Hoyt previously served as the head coach at Kansas City before joining Oklahoma State.
In the 2025-2026 season, Jacie Hoyt led the team to the NCAA Tournament as a No. 8 seed.
The 2025-2026 season marks Jacie Hoyt's third NCAA Tournament appearance in four seasons.
Jacie Hoyt has cited Cori Close as a mentor in her coaching career.
